label: v5_base_l1_s0_ep200_r3_stay_es0_probeq
note: no LSTM/recurrence involved -- q1_vec(t) regressed directly onto position(t), same (episode,t) pairs, to test whether h1->self R^2 requires temporal integration or is already achievable from a single timestep's Q vector alone
config_content:
# P1 v5 base stage, L1 refine (research_plan_v4_v5.md Sec.4.2). Q-input version
# of the paper's exp1_l1: everything frozen EXCEPT the decoder, refined with
# L1 loss. SM is frozen here, so no phase-transition concern -> 200ep (same as
# the paper) is enough; the long budget is only on v5_base_mse.
#
# Diff vs ROOT config/exp/exp1_l1.yml (4 lines):
#   model.name : SuperpositionNetworkFeaturePrediction -> SuperpositionNetworkProbeQ
#   data.name  : self_random_other_stay -> r3_stay
#   pretrain   : exp1_mse ep200 -> v5_base_mse ep400
#   train.freeze: [...] -> [...] + probe_critic  (A-1's critic is a given)
# max_epochs stays 200 (decoder-only). Everything else identical: l1_loss,
# batch 10, save_interval 10, test_interval 10, AdamW, lr 1e-3, wd 1e-2, bias wd=0.
#
# freeze list leaves ONLY vision_decoder_module trainable (substring match:
# "vision_encoder_module" catches both self_/other_ encoders).
model:
    name: SuperpositionNetworkProbeQ
    config: default
    mode: ~
runner: PredictionFeaturePredictionRunner
data:
    name: r3_stay
load_state_dict_strict: False
p_mask_vision: 0.99
train:
    loss_function: l1_loss
    pretrain:
        exp_config: v5_base_mse
        seed: 0
        epoch: 400
    batch_size: 10
    max_epochs: 200
    save_interval: 10
    test_interval: 10
    optimizer: AdamW
    optim_config:
        default:
            lr: 0.001
            weight_decay: 0.01
        freeze:
            - superposition_module
            - vision_encoder_module
            - integration_module
            - share_lns
            - feature_prediction_module
            - probe_critic
        per_params:
            - name: bias
              args:
                  weight_decay: 0.0
